conversions.policy: Each dependent pair crosses integer and FP registers. Signed conversion/move and two-conversion chains have equal warm duration. Round their maximum net pair cost / 2 upward to four cycles per conversion or FP register move. Only i32->f32 and f32->i32 signed conversions are calibrated.

fp_control.policy: Sign cost is ceil((sign-empty)/1024)=4. Cross-register move/compare and move/move chains use ceil(max(pair-empty)/2048)=4 cycles per operation, conservatively matching the typed conversion/move calibration. Only f32 sign and ordered comparisons are calibrated; control recipes charge composite comparisons separately.

calibration.policy: Dependent ALU/MUL/DIV/FP chains measured with mcycle. Branch/return and L1 load costs are conservative serial estimates, not complete processor timing. Unsupported FP/library operations require calibration.

software_model.mlir_mapping: static instruction recipes, not whole-program compiled timing
